text:
maria: Quick check — noticed an edge-case in the Dedicated provisioning docs around tenant labels. The SDK snippet uses `tenant_label: 'team_alpha'` but our backend treats underscores as invalid in some provisioning paths. People running the CLI get a 400 with `invalid_tenant_label`.
ben: ah yeah i've seen this in a support ticket. docs should call this out. do we prefer kebab-case or camelCase for labels?
maria: Implementation currently accepts letters, numbers, and hyphens only. We should update examples and add a validation note and a short regex.
josh: can we add a tiny snippet showing client-side validation? e.g. `if (!/^[a-z0-9-]{3,64}$/.test(label)) throw new Error('invalid label')` — keeps examples practical.
emily: +1. also: the SDK helper `createTenant()` silently strips underscores in one internal helper which causes misaligned records. that's a bug but docs should warn until SDK patch lands.
maria: copying the failing log from support (redacted):

```
POST /v1/dedicated/tenants 400 Bad Request
{
  "error": "invalid_tenant_label",
  "detail": "label contains invalid character '_'"
}
```

maria: Proposed doc changes:
- update YAML/SDK examples to use kebab-case labels (team-alpha)
- add a small validation snippet (js/python) near the quickstart
- add note in Troubleshooting: "400 invalid_tenant_label" with link to SDK issue
- mention the temporary behavior of the helper that strips underscores (and list patched SDK versions when available)

ben: sounds good. I'll file a tiny PR to the docs repo for the example changes and the troubleshooting blurb. PR will include JS and Python snippets.
josh: flagging another gotcha — tenant labels are used in telemetry keys. hyphens are fine but uppercase will be normalized to lowercase in logs. worth a one-liner.
emily: SDK bug: created issue in internal tracker: https://inc.internal/issue/RED-7654 (visibility: eng + support). I included stacktrace and repro.
sev_ops_bot: deploy-checklist: Please ensure docs PR references SDK PR that fixes stripping behavior, and add a temporary note in the troubleshooting section.
maria: Ben — can you also add a small regression test suggestion for the SDK sample? i.e. ensure `createTenant('team_alpha')` either rejects or returns explicit error instead of stripping.
ben: yep will add test snippet and note to PR description. putting a draft PR: https://git.internal/rw/docs/pulls/5821 (WIP)

josh: for the quickstart, here's a proposed JS validation snippet to paste in the PR:

```
function validateTenantLabel(label) {
  const ok = /^[a-z0-9-]{3,64}$/.test(label);
  if (!ok) throw new Error('Tenant label must be 3-64 chars, lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens');
}
```

emily: Also, add a short Python sample — folks using the CLI embed the label in a YAML and may not get runtime feedback until apply.
maria: Agreed. After Ben's PR lands, i'll open a follow-up to add a short note in the Dedicated provisioning troubleshooting matrix and add an example mapping of invalid -> recommended labels.

aI-docs-bot: Suggested docs wording (copyable): "Tenant labels must consist of lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only (3–64 chars). Labels containing other characters (e.g., underscores, spaces) will be rejected by the API. If you see a 400 invalid_tenant_label error, convert the label to kebab-case or update your SDK to the patched version."
ben: Nice — i used that in the PR body. one more ask: can UX/Docs add a small inline link to a label validator tool? maybe a tiny codepen or internal playground?
maria: we can add a link to the internal playground later — for now a copyable snippet is enough. we'll track the playground as a follow-up.
emily: once SDK fix ships i'll update the docs to show the SDK will surface a clear error (and list the fixed SDK versions).
josh: Action items summary:
- Ben: open/finish docs PR (examples + troubleshooting blurb + js/python snippets) — PR 5821 (due EOD Fri)
- Emily: keep SDK issue RED-7654 updated and post SDK PR link here when available
- Maria: follow-up to add troubleshooting matrix entry and playground link after docs PR lands
- Josh: add one-liner about telemetry normalization to quickstart section

maria: Thanks — assigning reviewers @ben @josh @emily. ping me when PR ready and i'll shepherd to merge. :thumbsup:

ben: thanks all — starting the PR now, will ping here when draft is up. :rocket:
